title: Services Leader at Cybersecurity and Cloud Data Protection Software Company Expects 20%–40% Growth in Twilio Voice and Messaging
expert: Professional services leader at a cybersecurity and cloud data-protection software company; runs a Twilio integration practice (current)
verdict: Across the ~10 accounts the expert serves, Twilio voice minutes and messages are up 20%–25% y/y with 9 of 10 customers growing, and new-project win rates rose to 80% from 50% after the May 2026 AI GA.

Messaging organic growth (ex-fees): 🟢 **Voice minutes and messages +20%–25% y/y; 9 of 10 customers grew** (first-hand) vs mgmt messaging +17% and voice 20%+ in 3Q26 (SB #64363, #67665): consistent; conflicts with the 2026-11-06 RingCentral call (share to ~60%). → Tenet 2 (organic ≥10%) ↑ {c1}
🟢 **4 of 10 customers renewed this quarter at +15%–20% spend, cycles 40%–50% shorter** (first-hand); first read. → Tenet 2 (organic ≥10%) ↑ {c9}
Voice AI minutes \u00d7 ConversationRela: 🟢 **New-project win rate 80% vs 50% before the May 2026 AI GA** (first-hand); first read. → Tenet 1 (AI agent layer) ↑ {c6}
🟢 **~50% of AI POCs reach production; next quarter minutes/messages +20%–40%** (estimate); first read. → Tenet 1 (AI agent layer) ↑ {c20}
Gross profit dollar growth vs organic re: 🔴 **Outbound voice \$1.40 per 100 min vs Telnyx \$0.70; SMS \$0.83 vs Plivo \$0.50** (list prices), yet no migrations seen; first read. → Tenet 5 (carrier moat) → {c11}

changes: Voice and messaging volumes **+20%–25% y/y** (first-hand) vs mgmt messaging organic +17% and voice 20%+ in 3Q26 (SB #64363, SB #67665): consistent.

thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (AI agent layer): ↑ — win rate 80% from 50% since the AI GA; Conversation Relay and Conversation Intelligence drive the volume gains.
Tenet 2 (organic growth ≥10%): ↑ — volumes +20%–25% y/y and renewals at +15%–20% spend.
Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue): → — list prices stable, carrier fees passed through.
Tenet 5 (carrier moat): → — rivals list 40%–50% lower but the expert saw no migrations; one deal lost to Telnyx on price.
